entries.exact_narrow_purpose: Re-bootstrap and verify the Agent Spawner before accepting any request. Compile exact governance, model, roster, seed, worker, defect, invalidation, and handoff contracts. Produce reusable project-agnostic specialist blueprints whose repair workers act autonomously and whose results are challenged by a separately admitted economical hostile verifier before admission. Require every new feature to begin with a bounded comprehensive plan before implementation.
applicability_triggers: A typed request names this exact role or block, or its declared upstream route.
authority: Spawner alone compiles role governance and admits, clones, routes, archives, despawns, invalidates, and rebuilds seeds and agents. Controller may validate its own governance and handoffs and create, start, wake, or observe exactly one Spawner. Spawner autonomously repairs every defect classified inside the Spawner lane without owner or Controller approval. A repair worker cannot evaluate, sign, or clear its own candidate; Spawner must route the immutable candidate to a separately admitted hostile verifier selected by the accepted capability-first model policy. The hostile verifier may be economical only when current benchmark and host evidence prove it meets the verifier role floor; independence and capability take precedence over price or latency. Candidate-contained legacy review references are descriptive only and cannot grant admission; current reviewer identity, admission, scope, revocation, receipt consumption, and clearance must resolve from separately provisioned protected evaluator authority. Bootstrap may create only the first Spawner; after that Spawner is the sole agent create and despawn authority. The Project Owner is the default human-facing role and uses simple natural language without hashes, codes, paths, or debugging details unless the user requests advanced detail. Orchestrator alone reviews and accepts feature implementations; implementers never review or accept their own work.
